name: AwoExpense
author: AwoScan

sections.description:
AwoExpense 2.2.0 is a self-contained corporate B2B expense, purchase invoice, and A4 accounting summary studio for WordPress (WP Admin -> AwoExpense). All built-in features are completely unlocked locally inside WordPress with zero artificial limits.

What AwoExpense Does

AwoExpense centralizes employee expense receipts, supplier purchase invoices, multi-rate VAT calculations, 4-stage manager approvals, bilingual A4 reporting in 10 languages (TR, EN, DE, ES, FR, RU, AR RTL, ZH, JA, KO), Ek-1 photo appendix printing, CSV export, and JSON backup/restore into one WordPress admin workspace.

How to Configure and Use AwoExpense

  1. Open the Studio: After activating the plugin, click AwoExpense in the WordPress admin sidebar (requires manage_options capability).
  2. Configure Company Settings: Configure your company name, language (plus optional bilingual secondary language), currency, and default VAT percentages (20, 10, 1, 0) in the sidebar settings.
  3. Create or Select a Record: Upload a receipt/invoice photo (JPEG/PNG up to 2 MB), enter supplier details, gross amount, VAT rate, and optional stock line items, then send it into the approval workflow.
  4. Calculate, Filter, and Manage Status: Review pending items in the Manager Approval queue (Pending -> Approved / Returned) and filter records by keyword or category.
  5. Save, Print A4 PDF, or Export: Click Save to WordPress to store records safely in wp_options (awoexpense_workspace_v1), click Print A4 to generate the wet-signature A4 accounting summary (with optional Ek-1 numbered receipt photo appendix), or export to CSV / JSON.

Key Features

  • Live Two-Column Studio & Instant A4 Print Preview: Edit records on the left and print formatted single-page or multi-page (Ek-1 photo appendix) A4 corporate accounting summaries (@media print ready).
  • 100% Local WordPress Database Storage: Stores workspace records, rolling backups, AI settings (awoexpense_ai_settings_v1), and stock bridge items (awoexpense_stock_bridge_v1) safely inside your own WordPress wp_options table via Nonce-verified and manage_options-restricted AJAX.
  • 10 Global Languages & Bilingual A4 Output: Supports Turkish, English, German, Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic (RTL), Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
  • CSV & Portable JSON Export / Import: Export approved records to Excel-compatible CSV or full workspace backups to JSON at any time.
  • Adaptive Day / Night UI: Supports automatic system theme detection as well as manual Light and Dark modes.

External Services

  • 100% Local Default Operation: By default, AwoExpense runs 100% locally inside your WordPress site and makes zero automatic external HTTP requests. All core expense, invoice, approval, CSV, JSON, and A4 print features work completely offline on your server.
  • Optional Local Ollama Vision Runtime (User-Initiated): If an administrator configures a local or intranet Ollama endpoint (for example http://localhost:11434) and explicitly confirms the OCR consent dialog, receipt parsing runs inside the administrator’s configured Ollama instance.
  • Optional Groq Cloud Vision API (User-Initiated with Explicit Consent): Only if an administrator manually selects Groq Cloud API, enters an API key, and checks the explicit consent checkbox before running AI OCR is the selected receipt sent to Groq Cloud API (https://api.groq.com).
    • Terms & Privacy Policy: https://groq.com/terms-of-service/ and https://groq.com/privacy-policy/
  • Optional WhatsApp Web Deep-Link (wa.me, User-Initiated with Explicit Consent): Only when an administrator clicks WhatsApp Summary and confirms the preview consent dialog does the browser open a https://wa.me/ share link containing the summarized totals.
    • Terms & Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service and https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
  • Developer Privacy Information: https://awoscan.com/privacy

Privacy and Data Storage

AwoExpense stores all records, company settings, AI settings (awoexpense_ai_settings_v1), stock bridge items (awoexpense_stock_bridge_v1), and uploaded receipt images locally inside your WordPress site (wp_options and wp-content/uploads/awoexpense/). No business records or customer data are transmitted to external servers without explicit administrator action and consent. All stored options are automatically removed when the plugin is uninstalled (uninstall.php).

Source Code

All PHP, JavaScript, and CSS files in this plugin are distributed in human-readable, unminified source form directly inside the plugin directory (no external build tool or compiler is required):

  • awoexpense.php – Core WordPress admin page, AJAX workspace persistence, field-level sanitization, and option management.
  • expense-view.php – WordPress admin and [awoexpense] shortcode studio HTML template.
  • includes/awoexpense-lec-adapter.php – Capabilities helper and 10-language (LTR/RTL/CJK) catalog.
  • assets/awoexpense.js – Expense receipt studio, VAT math, 4-stage approval workflow, CSV/JSON export, and A4 accounting summary renderer.
  • assets/awoexpense.css – Admin studio layout and @media print A4 accounting summary styles.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the awoexpense folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or upload awoexpense-free-2.2.0.zip via Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin in WordPress.
  2. Activate AwoExpense through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Click AwoExpense in the WordPress admin sidebar (manage_options capability required).
  4. Configure your company header, add your records, click Save to WordPress, and use Print A4 to generate your accounting summary.
sections.faq:
Does AwoExpense require an external account or license key to work?

No. AwoExpense runs locally inside WordPress out of the box with all features unlocked and no external account or license key required.

Where is my data stored?

All data is stored in your own WordPress database inside the wp_options table (awoexpense_workspace_v1, awoexpense_workspace_backup_v1, awoexpense_vault_v1, awoexpense_ai_settings_v1, awoexpense_stock_bridge_v1) and uploaded receipt images reside in wp-content/uploads/awoexpense/.

Can I print A4 documents or save them as PDF?

Yes. Click the Print A4 button inside the studio to open your browser’s native print dialog, where you can print directly to an A4 printer or choose “Save as PDF”.
sections.changelog:
2.2.0

  • Unlocked all built-in features natively inside WordPress (10 languages, bilingual A4 print, Ek-1 photo appendix, CSV export, WhatsApp summary, AI OCR, stock bridge, and 5,000-record capacity) with zero licensing or trialware restrictions.
  • Added strict field-level sanitization (map_deep + awoexpense_sanitize_stock_bridge() + awoexpense_sanitize_ai_settings()) and distinct awoexpense_ option prefixes across all database options.
  • Removed unused external licensing endpoints and updated readme.txt external service disclosures.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of AwoExpense corporate studio for WordPress.
